verses.pali: “Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, aññaṁ ekaphoṭṭhabbampi samanupassāmi yaṁ evaṁ purisassa cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṁ, bhikkhave, itthiphoṭṭhabbo.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I do not see a single touch that occupies a man’s mind like the touch of a woman.

verses.pali: Itthiphoṭṭhabbo, bhikkhave, purisassa cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī”ti.
verses.english: The touch of a woman occupies a man’s mind.”
